Selective incandescent glow around lights, only in the game. May increase GPU use. Applies when opening or returning to the game.
Resolution, image filters and frame limit
Wait for preparation to finish before changing game files.
Wait for the save operation to finish before playing.
Smooths jagged edges in the game image. Text and fine details may look softer.
At zero, extra sharpening is off; FSR keeps a soft RCAS setting. Increase gradually; high values may create outlines around details.
Upscales a lower game resolution to the displayed area. Choose a lower resolution above. Includes RCAS; the sharpening control adjusts it without adding CAS.
Adapts intermediate frames to the game FPS and display refresh rate. Uses more GPU and may increase latency or leave trails. If it fails, the game continues without generation for this session.
Filters affect only the game and apply when opening or returning to it. Combining effects increases GPU use; disable some if performance drops.
Genesis estimates relief and motion from the game itself. Lumen uses that relief to reconstruct lighting. Low-confidence scenes keep the original image.
Pauses optional effects and the PDA while keeping your preferences.
In Fit mode, lights only the unused borders. At zero intensity, the borders stay black.
